summary: ```markdown # Introduction to New Features of Marvelous Designer 2025.1 - Drawing Patterns in 3D Space In this video, we explore the exciting new features of Marvelous Designer 2025.1, focusing on the 3D pen tool and its capabilities for drawing patterns in 3D space. ## Creating a 3D Version of a 3D Pen In 3D space, you can create a 3D version of a 3D pen. Through the new 3D pen tool, you can create this directly in 3D space. - **Straight Lines:** When clicking, press the Shift key to create a straight line. - **Line Length Adjustment:** On the created line, press the right key to select the length of the display or hidden line. - **Switching to 3D Version:** Press the P key to switch the pen to a 3D version in 3D space. ## Creating Curves and Editing Lines When creating a line, press the Ctrl key and click to create a curve. By editing the 3D pen tool, you can adjust the position of the straight line and the curve. - **Automatic Curve Creation:** When dividing the version by line, the lines will automatically create a curve along the shared division line. - **Hidden Points:** When creating a line, press the D key to switch the hidden point of the creation to the distance from the virtual model. You can first rely on the virtual model to draw some lines. ## Adjusting and Deleting Lines Then, press the P key to continue drawing lines in 3D space to form a version. Please adjust the version line by adjusting these points. Then, click the right button to delete it. - **Continuing Line Creation:** When creating a line, press the right button to continue drawing lines in 3D space. - **Extreme Curves:** When creating a line, press the left button to extreme the curve. ## Combining Panels and Sewing In this application, you can integrate a line into the 3D space. The sleeve panels do not need to be separated, so we can combine them. - **Sewing Techniques:** Use the line sewing machine and the free sewing machine to sew the panels together. - **Symmetrical Panels:** When one side of the panel is finished, use the symmetrical panel, panel, and sewing line tools to create the symmetrical panel on the other side. Then sew the panels on both sides together. ## Final Touches and Simulation Finally, simulate and inspect your clothing. That's all for this video. See you next time! ```
